title: Design: Default tag shows after the term name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design pictures ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png, ct-p1-10-saved.png, ct-p4-01-active-tab-after-deactivating-everything-it-can.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Settings page.
custom_steps:
1. In the Settings menu, click "Credit Terms".
  2. Click "⋯" on the Net 30 row.
  3. Click "Make Default for New Customers".
  4. Click "Make Default".
  5. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • On the Due on Receipt row a light-blue "Default" pill with blue text follows the name, after the info icon and the lock icon, and no other row has the pill (as in ct-p1-01-active-tab-one-table.png).

Step 2:

  • The row menu opens.

Step 3:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 4:

  • The "Default" pill now follows "Net 30" directly (Net 30 has no icons) and has left Due on Receipt (as in ct-p1-10-saved.png).

Step 5:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S1-R11: “The shop's default term shows a "Default" tag after its name (after the info and lock icons for COD and Due on Receipt). Exactly one row carries the tag.”
  • S2-R6: “On "Make Default", the term becomes the default, the "Default" tag moves to its row, and a success toast shows "{name} is now the default" with the line "New customers start on {name}." No customer, vendor or invoice changes.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
